content: Goday Milkiyaasa baggara Isra7eele asaas odida tinbite qaalay haysa.
Goday ba asaako, “Ta hintena dosas” yaagees. Shin hinte, “Ne nuna aybin dosadii?” yaageeta. Goday zaaridi, “Eesawey Yayqooba isha gidenneyee? Shin taani Yayqooba dosas;
Eesawe ixas. Taani derey dariya Eesawe biitta baysa oothas; iya laata workanati gupiya mela biitta oothas” yaagees.

Eesawe koche gidida Edoome asay, “Nu katamati laaletikoka, nu enta zaaridi keexana” yaagikoka, Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday, “Enti zaaridi keexana, shin taani laallana. Asay enta, ‘Ha biittay iita biitta; ha asayka Goday merinaw hanqetida ase’ yaagana” yaagees.
Hessa hinte, hinte ayfen be7idi, “Heko, Goday Isra7eele biittafe karenka wolqaama” yaagana.

Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday haysada yaagees: “Hinteno, ta sunthaa kawushiya kahineto, na7i ba aawa, aylley ba godaa bonchees. Yaatin, taani hintew aawa gidiko, hinte tana bonchiya bonchoy awunee? Taani hintew godaa gidiko, hinte taw yayiya yashay awunee? Hinte ta sunthaa kawushshideta. Hinte zaaridi, ‘Nuuni ne sunthaa waatidi kawushshido?’ yaageeta.
“Hinte ta yarsho bessan tuna kathi wotheta. Qassi, ‘Nuuni nena waatidi tunisido?’ yaageeta. Hinte, ‘Godaa yarsho bessay kadhetidaba’ yaagidi tana tunisideta.

Hinte qooqe mehe yarshiya wode hessi qoho gidenneyee? Hinte hargancho woyko wobe mehe yarshiya wode hessi qoho gidenneyee? Hinte hessa mela mehe hinte halaqaas immiyako, I hessa ekanabaanne iyan ufaytanaaba hintew daanii? yaagees Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday.
“Ha77i Xoossay hintew qadhetana mela iya woossite. Wona hinte hessa mela imota iyaw immin, I hintena maaddanee?” yaagees Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday.
“Hinte ta yarsho bessan hada tama eethonna mela xoossa keetha pengiya gordiya issi asi bentida gidereneshin! Ta hintenan ufaytike; hinte immiya imotaka ekike” yaagees Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday.

“Awi doliyasope wulliyaso gakanaw ta sunthay kawotethata giddon wolqaama. Ubba bessan ta sunthaas ixaane cuyisananne geeshsha yarsho yarshana; ta sunthay kawotethata giddon wolqaama” yaagees Ubbaafe Wolqaama Goday.
“Shin hinte, ‘Godaa yarsho bessay tuna; iyan yarshetiya kathika kadhetidaba’ yaagidi iya kawushshideta.
Qassi hinte, ‘Haysi coo daabursi’ yaagidi, qidhidi cuttideta. “Hinte bonqidi ehidaba woyko wobe woyko hargancho mehe yarsheeta; yaatin, taani hessa hinte kushepe ekanaw bessii?

Taani gita kawo; ta sunthayka kawotethata giddon bonchetidaysa gidiya gisho, Xoossas immana gidi doorida marazey iya mehiya giddon de7ishin, iya aggidi, boretida maraze yarsho shiishiya asinne cimmiya asi baadetidaba gido” yaagees Goday.
